title: file_pull
description: An admin asked for a file from this PC (panel **Dosya al**). Sent only to a connected agent that reported `files_enabled: true`, by a server that lists `file_transfer`. The agent reads `path` (applying its own profile rules: without `any_profile` it does not read other users' profile folders), refuses files larger than `max_size`, uploads the file once to `upload` on its own server with its device secret headers and answers with `file_result`. The body of the upload is the raw file (`application/octet-stream`; a multipart field `file` is accepted too); an optional `X-Content-SHA256` header is checked by the server.

path.description: Full local path with a drive letter. The server never sends network paths, device paths, `.`/`..` parts, wildcards or alternate data streams.

max_size.description: Largest accepted size in bytes; a larger upload is cut off with 413 and the transfer fails.

upload.description: Path on the agent's own server: `POST` with `X-Agent-Id` and `X-Agent-Secret`. The token in `t` works once (it is used up when the upload starts) and for 1 hour.

any_profile.description: Only a superadmin can set it: the file may also come from another user's profile.
